subject: inquiry on simulation using cov matirix

messages.author: c69c89eff5f12d04
messages.subject: inquiry on simulation using cov matirix
parts:
Hi group,
In Mplus, means and covariance matrix data type cannot be analyzed in Montecarlo simulation, and I got an error message that "External Monte Carlo requires individual raw data". 

Is it possible in MplusAutomation of R?
Is there any helpful material?

Best,

Sookyoung Son,

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: inquiry on simulation using cov matirix
parts:
Hi Sookyoung,

In this case, I would encourage you to use the mean and covariance matrix to simulate data in R that matches the desired structure. There are a variety of tools for doing so, but the mvrnorm function in the MASS package is quite common. Below is an example that I have used in my SEM class taken from Brown's CFA book (Ch. 8), which may give a sense of how to approach the problem.

Best,
Michael


rawdat <- '
1.00
0.78  1.00
0.80  0.77  1.00
0.56  0.51  0.48  1.00
0.52  0.51  0.46  0.78  1.00
0.59  0.51  0.51  0.80  0.79  1.00
0.16  0.15  0.17  0.14  0.18  0.16  1.00
0.19  0.13  0.18  0.14  0.16  0.16  0.81  1.00
0.12  0.17  0.17  0.17  0.20  0.16  0.75  0.80  1.00
0.16  0.13  0.17  0.15  0.16  0.18  0.56  0.52  0.50  1.00
0.16  0.14  0.18  0.15  0.16  0.18  0.51  0.58  0.51  0.81  1.00
0.16  0.15  0.14  0.16  0.16  0.14  0.52  0.57  0.52  0.80  0.79  1.00
'

#standard deviations of variables
sds <- as.numeric(strsplit('1.40  2.10  1.30  2.30  2.40  1.90  2.00  2.90  2.30  3.10  2.20  1.20', '\\s+', perl=TRUE)[[1]])

cormat <- getCov(rawdat)

#this is the covariance matrix to be analyzed
covmat <- lavaan::cor2cov(cormat, sds)

rownames(covmat) <- colnames(covmat) <- c("P1", "P2", "P3", "C1", "C2", "C3", "E1", "E2", "E3", "S1", "S2", "S3")

df <- mvrnorm(n=275, mu=rep(0, 12), Sigma=covmat, empirical = TRUE)
